caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical horse and rider. The horse is colored in shades of brown and beige, with darker brown for the mane, upper neck, and the exterior of its body, while its lower legs, underbelly, and part of the torso are beige. The horse is in a dynamic pose, lifting its front left leg as if in motion, and it stands on a round brown base. Straps and harnesses, rendered in brown and black, attach the horse to a chariot-like cart. The cart has two large red spoked wheels and is depicted in a beige or light tan color, matching the main color scheme. Seated in the cart is a human figure dressed in beige or light brown clothing, including a cap, jacket, and pants. The figure is holding the reins attached to the horse and is looking forward. The entire composition is set against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Trotter in Action
